question: What is the protein half-life of ALB according to the Human Protein Atlas?

turns.text:
The protein half-life of ALB (Albumin) **cannot be determined from the Human Protein Atlas data available through these tools**.

I checked the HPA records for ALB (gene description: Albumin; Ensembl ENSG00000163631; UniProt P02768) via the protein information and protein class endpoints. The Human Protein Atlas does **not** report protein half-life values — none of the HPA fields returned (gene annotation, protein classes, expression data, subcellular localization, pathology, etc.) include a half-life measurement for ALB or any other protein.

If you need a half-life figure for albumin (commonly cited as ~19 days in circulation from pharmacokinetic literature, not from HPA), that would come from external sources, not from the Human Protein Atlas.
